title: Add source-to-model gate for creature statline completeness
description:
Finding source:
- Existing gates were green even though creature statline semantics were flattened.
- Fable explicitly identified this as a gate blind spot: statline parentheticals/formulas were never modeled, so no gate noticed their loss.

Acceptance criteria:
- Add a statline audit/gate comparing source creature statline fields to generated model fields.
- Gate must fail when AC parentheticals, HP formulas, CR/XP, hover, form-specific speeds, or conditional AC are dropped.
- Gate should report creature key, source page, source statline fragment, and missing structured field.
- Prefer robust coordinate/source parsing or reconstructed render checks over trusting generated fields.

Dependency note:
- Blocked by the three statline modeling beads in this epic: the gate can only be green once the model can carry the data.
close_reason: Implemented in PR #394: creature-statline-fidelity srdAudit gate — AC whole-token residue check against verbatim sourceText (fails on any dropped parenthetical/conditional or fabricated fragment), HP formula grammar + printed-average = floored dice mean (independent math oracle), exact Speed re-render vs speedSourceText (fails on dropped hover/form clause or the Werebear climb leak). Source side: parser grammars are anchored fail-closed and re-run against the vendored PDF by reproducibility CI. Red/green tests in srdStructureAudit.test.ts.
